user.title: Search for a ZKTeco device
user.description: Looks for PullSDK / ZKAccess devices (C3, inBio, MA500...): broadcast on Home Assistant's network and TCP port 4370 tried on {own}. A device on another subnet or VLAN is only found when you add its range below. Do not manage the device from ZKAccess at the same time.

select.title: Device
select.description: {count} device(s) found. A device already set up is marked as such.

connect.title: Connect to the device
connect.description: Check the address and enter the communication password if there is one.

data_description.password: Leave empty when there is no communication password.

dhcp_confirm.title: ZKTeco device found
dhcp_confirm.description: A ZKTeco device was found at {host}. Set it up?

reconfigure.title: Device address
reconfigure.description: Change the address, port or communication password. People, categories, phones and history are kept.

data_description.password: Leave empty when there is no communication password.

reauth_confirm.title: Communication password
reauth_confirm.description: The device at {host} refuses the communication password. Enter the current one (empty when none).

error.no_devices: No device found. Add the device's range (e.g. 192.168.5.0/24), or submit again unchanged to enter its address.

abort.wrong_device: Another device answers at this address (different serial number).

data.sync_clock: Set the device clock on connection

set_user.name: Create or update a user
set_user.description: Creates the UserID or updates the given fields; other fields are kept. Advanced: acts on a raw UserID, outside the person / category model; prefer the panel or Set access.

user_id.name: UserID
user_id.description: Number of the user on the device (typed on the keypad).

delete_user.name: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Deletes a UserID with its fingerprints and door authorizations. Advanced: acts on a raw UserID, outside the person / category model; prefer the panel or Set access.

user_id.name: UserID
user_id.description: Number of the user on the device (typed on the keypad).

grant.name: Grant access
grant.description: Allows a UserID to open doors during a time zone. Advanced: acts on a raw UserID, outside the person / category model; prefer the panel or Set access.

user_id.name: UserID
user_id.description: Number of the user on the device (typed on the keypad).

timezone.name: Time zone
timezone.description: Time zone id (1 = always on factory devices).

doors.name: Doors
doors.description: Door bit mask: 1 = door 1, 2 = door 2, 4 = door 3, 8 = door 4.

revoke.name: Revoke access
revoke.description: Removes every door authorization of a UserID. Advanced: acts on a raw UserID, outside the person / category model; prefer the panel or Set access.

user_id.name: UserID
user_id.description: Number of the user on the device (typed on the keypad).

open_door.name: Open door
open_door.description: Energizes the lock relay for a few seconds.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the device clock to Home Assistant's local time.

list_users.name: List users
list_users.description: Returns the UserIDs stored in the device.

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Saves people, fingerprints, cards and access rights to a JSON file in the zkaccess_native/backups folder of the configuration directory.

set_access.name: Set access
set_access.description: Enable or disable a person's access, or only one of their categories (the device refuses the credentials, Home Assistant treats them as denied).

category.name: Category
category.description: Category digit (0-9). Empty: the whole person.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to allow, off to refuse.

rename_person.name: Rename a person
rename_person.description: Change the name of a person (written to the device for all their UserIDs).

not_loaded.message: {device} is not a loaded ZKAccess device.

unknown_person.message: No person number {person} on this device.

identify_undoing.message: The previous identification is still being undone, try again in a few seconds.
